summary_en: Public tender offer by TCG2511 K.K. (ALSOK affiliate) for all ordinary shares of Nihon Dry Chemical K.K. (TSE Standard, code 1909) closed 2026-06-29. Tendered shares: 22,403,872 (within range 13,465,700–no upper limit). Minimum acceptance threshold 13,465,700 shares met. ALSOK held 4,400,000 shares (16.4% post-split); four restricted directors' shares (10,832) excluded from offer pool.
title_en: Notice regarding results of public tender offer for ordinary shares of Nihon Dry Chemical Co., Ltd. by TCG2511 K.K.
translation_en_brief: TCG2511 K.K. (a subsidiary vehicle affiliated with ALSOK Co., Ltd.) commenced a public tender offer on 14 May 2026 for all ordinary shares of Nihon Dry Chemical Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, code 1909). The tender offer closed on 29 June 2026. The tender offer had a minimum acceptance threshold of 13,465,700 shares and no stated upper limit; the maximum potential acquisition was 22,403,872 shares (derived by taking the target's 26,814,704 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 31 March 2026, less ALSOK's pre-existing 4,400,000-share stake and 10,832 restricted shares held by four directors). The filing does not disclose the tender price, final tendered volume, or takedown percentage. This announcement serves as the closing result notice; full terms and final acceptance data appear in the attached primary disclosure from TCG2511.
